chapters.reason: The paper focuses on masked diffusion large language models (dLLMs), which operate by predicting masked tokens in a non-autoregressive, coarse-to-fine manner, directly aligning with the description of Masked Diffusion Models.

The paper introduces specialized training strategies, including masked supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and a novel RL algorithm (diffu-GRPO), to improve reasoning in pre-trained dLLMs, which fits the category of Training Strategies for Recurrent Reasoning.

The work adapts pre-trained masked dLLMs via fine-tuning and RL to develop latent reasoning capabilities without architectural modifications, aligning with Training-induced Recurrence that unlocks latent capacity through training.
